messages:
incidents-bot: Pager alert -> streaming-gateway critical: sudden 5xx spike + connection resets on long-lived streams. Alert: https://pager.redwood/alert/INC-4321
maria (oncall): I'm on it. Region-specific? customer impact numbers?
jason (eng-runtime): Quick triage: envoy fronting streaming conns returning 502/524. Logs show repeated 'upstream reset' and 'client cancelled', plus chunk parse errors with partial frames. We have a config rollout ~30m ago (envoy listener tweak) and a kernel backport landed on pool-2 nodes at ~08:12 UTC.
neha (infra): Confirmed kernel update on pool-2; nodes restarted during the rolling update. Could be an epoll/tcp keepalive regression.
tom (sre): Error rate jumped from ~0.2% -> 5.4% over last 10m for /v1/stream. Affected: hosted gateway and some dedicated pools. Top impacted customers: cust-334, cust-998 (high RPS).
olivia (support): Opened tickets with both customers. They report mid-stream hangups and aborted responses; clients retrying. No data corruption reported.
jason (eng-runtime): Reproduced locally: when envoy resets mid-chunk client gets partial chunk + socket close. Local logs:
```
ERR: http2: stream reset: RST_STREAM
WARN: chunk parse error: unexpected EOF
```
maria (oncall): Mitigation options? rollback kernel, revert envoy change, fallback to paged endpoints?
jae (platform): We can shift streaming traffic away from pool-2 to pool-1 by adjusting routing weights. I can flip 60% traffic in ~2m.
neha (infra): I can livepatch ingress: increase tcp_keepalive_time, disable the new epoll option, and restart envoy instances in a rolling way. Doing that now.
jason (eng-runtime): We also have a runtime flag 'stream.fallback' that converts streaming requests to paged delivery for new requests. Can enable per-customer.
tom (sre): Prioritize: 1) divert streaming traffic off pool-2 2) enable per-customer streaming->paged fallback 3) ingress livepatch / rolling restarts 4) rollback kernel AMI if no improvement.
incidents-bot: Action created: #INC-4321 assigned to maria (oncall) and neha (infra). Auto-escalation enabled.
maria (oncall): Routing change applied: shifted 60% traffic from pool-2 -> pool-1 (routing-id r-2026-03-15-01). Observed error rate drop to ~3.1% within 5m.
jason (eng-runtime): Enabled stream.fallback for cust-334 and cust-998. Their error rates dropped to ~0.5% (customer-reported improvement).
neha (infra): Ingress livepatch applied: increased keepalive, disabled the new epoll flag, restarted envoy on 6/8 nodes in pool-2 (rolling). Partial-frame errors trending down.
olivia (support): Cust-334 confirmed improvement; cust-998 asks for ETA on full fix.
maria (oncall): Plan: finish rolling restarts, monitor 15m windows. If error rate <=0.5% after full rollout, we'll mark mitigated. If not, prepare kernel rollback. Escalating overnight to second oncall: tom (sre).
maria (oncall): Handoff notes:
- Impact: streaming disconnects + partial chunk frames on /v1/stream
- Mitigations applied: routing shift, per-customer fallback, ingress keepalive livepatch, rolling restarts (6/8 done)
- Next steps: complete restarts, monitor, prepare rollback plan for kernel AMI (neha)
- Incident ref: #INC-4321
tom (sre): Taking over. I'll watch dashboards and coordinate rollback if errors resurge. Drop logs in #eng-runtime.
jason (eng-runtime): Pushed extra chunk-parser + backpressure logging. Useful command to fetch recent logs:
```
kubectl logs -n redwood streaming-gateway --since=30m | grep -E "partial|chunk parse|upstream reset"
```
neha (infra): Rolling restarts finishing in ~35m. Holding off rollback for now; if stable we'll run postmortem after 24h cool-down.
maria (oncall): I'll update incident to 'mitigated' when error rate <0.5% for 30m. Thanks team :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident #INC-4321 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring (changed by maria) at 3245681200
tom (sre): Handoff complete. Monitoring continues.
